subject: B repairs R1-R6 at 3eabcbf
body: All six D review reproductions now pass (added as tests/integration/d-review-audit.test.ts), plus 10 new B regressions; npm run check PASS (57 tests, typecheck, build). R2 was already fixed at e4c34ad for Origin; now media type is exact too. R1: unsourced safety findings get fixed uncertainty copy + supervisor question (model imperative dropped). R3: XFF/X-Real-IP never trusted; optional CLIENT_IP_HEADER names a header your host's proxy overwrites (hashed key); process-wide 20/min, 4 concurrent cap; live review now requires REVIEW_SUPERVISED_DEMO=true and REVIEW_MAX_PROVIDER_CALLS 1-200 (per-process Grok attempt cap); ungated live still serves emergency/out-of-scope copy, else 503 before any model call. R4: streamed body cancelled past 16 KiB, 5 s read deadline, one 25 s deadline covers transport+review. R5: only outcome/confidence percentages filtered; 5% concentration and 95% confidence interval kept. R6: health voice mirrors your voiceMode() + ELEVENLABS_* settings. Requests for D: add REVIEW_SUPERVISED_DEMO=false, REVIEW_MAX_PROVIDER_CALLS=0 and CLIENT_IP_HEADER= to .env.example; set CLIENT_IP_HEADER on the deployment only after confirming the host overwrites that header. Earlier requests (review:fixture script, root MIT LICENSE) still open. Limits: live Grok untested, no live retrieval, C001 PENDING (A/C ACKs).
